name: PB_COLL_STEP_HX_TBL
description: This table contains information about the history of all collection processes on a PBA. This includes the step the process moved to, the date that the move happened, and the amount of money outstanding from the transactions in collections.

columns.name: PB_ACCT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the account record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PB_COLL_STEP_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the history of the collections step on the account.

columns.name: PB_MOD_HX_DATE
columns.description: Stores the history of when the collections step was modified on the account.

columns.name: PB_AMT_OUTST_HX
columns.description: Stores the history of the amount outstanding from transactions that are in collections.

columns.name: PB_COLL_STEP_NUM
columns.description: The unique ID for the collection process on the account.

columns.name: WHO_COMP_STEP_HX_USER_ID
columns.description: Stores the history of the user that completed each step in a collections process.

columns.name: WHO_COMP_STEP_HX_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: WAS_STEP_SKIP_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether this step of the collection process was manually skipped.

columns.name: PB_COLL_STAT_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the history of the collections status on the account.

columns.name: COLL_PHONE_CALL_COMM_ID
columns.description: Stores the history of any CRM cases that were opened in each step of a collections process.
